sources.entry: Copay - A secure bitcoin wallet platform for both desktop and mobile devices.

summary.one_liner: Copay is a bitcoin wallet project from BitPay whose README says it has been replaced by the "Bitpay Wallet" apps, with a warning about fake copies.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a short deprecation notice rather than a description of features. It states that the Copay wallet is now Bitpay Wallet and directs users to migrate to the Bitpay Wallet apps on the app stores. It links to a new repository and download pages, but the link targets are blank in the text provided. It also warns that fake Copay wallets on the Google Play Store for Android may steal coins, and tells users to install only "Bitpay Wallet" with the developer listed as "BITPAY INC". The README gives no build, usage, or API details.
use_cases: check whether Copay is still the official bitcoin wallet
find the current BitPay wallet app
migrate from Copay to Bitpay Wallet
notable: Deprecation notice pointing users to the Bitpay Wallet apps
Warns of fake Copay wallets on Google Play that may steal funds
Says the official app developer should be listed as BITPAY INC
caveats: The README is a migration notice and does not describe current development or features
The project has been replaced by Bitpay Wallet, so this repository is likely no longer the main app
